residency_notes: Venice does not publish a fixed execution or data-residency location for the API. Its proxy does not store prompt or response content, but the selected model privacy mode controls downstream handling: Private models use contract-enforced zero-retention infrastructure, while Anonymous models may be retained by the upstream provider.
prompt_training_notes: Venice says its proxy does not store or log prompt and response content for normal inference. Private models use zero-data-retention infrastructure, but Anonymous models are relayed to upstream providers whose own retention policies apply; operational metadata is still processed.
